# ShipAI Lab - Complete Information

> AI SaaS & Product Development in 15 Days

## Company Overview

ShipAI Lab is a specialized AI development agency that builds and launches AI-powered SaaS, web, and mobile products in just 15 days. We offer fixed pricing, expert team support, and proven results for startups and businesses looking to bring their AI ideas to market quickly.

## Core Services

### 1. SaaS Platforms
Build scalable, user-friendly SaaS solutions tailored to your business needs. We handle:
- Architecture design and database modeling
- User authentication and authorization
- Payment integration and subscription management
- Admin dashboards and analytics
- API development and third-party integrations
- Scalable cloud infrastructure setup

### 2. Mobile & Web Apps
Create high-performance mobile and web apps designed for user engagement and success:
- Cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android)
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- Responsive web applications
- Modern UI/UX design
- Real-time features and notifications
- App store deployment

### 3. AI-Powered Apps
Develop innovative AI applications to automate processes and drive business growth:
- Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications
- Computer Vision solutions
- AI content generation tools
- Machine Learning model integration
- AI automation workflows
- Custom AI chatbots and assistants

## Sober Girl (consumer app and guides)

Sober Girl is a private sobriety tracker for women, made by Ship AI Lab (Ship AI Solutions, LLC). It counts sober days and money saved, with a daily check-in, a Craving SOS (breathing exercise and 10-minute timer), milestone badges and a tree that grows as you stay sober. Core tools are free; Plus adds a private journal, mood insights and shareable milestone cards. Available on Google Play for Android (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sobergirl.app); the iPhone version is coming soon. It is not treatment and has not been tested in a published trial.

App page: https://shipailab.com/sobergirl
Guides hub: https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/guides

Sourced guides and free tools (28; every figure links to its source; updated 2026-10-06):

- [Best Sober Tracker Apps (2026): Compared by Use](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/best-sober-tracker-apps): Six sober tracker apps compared by what each is best for, cost, devices and ratings, from their store listings, plus what trials say about whether apps work.
- [Sobriety Milestones: 1 Day to 1 Year, What Is Known](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sobriety-milestones): What research does and does not say at 1 day, 1 week, 30 days, 90 days, 6 months and 1 year without alcohol. Sourced, with a money-saved calculator.
- [Sober October: How to Do It, and What the Evidence Says](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-october): A practical guide to Sober October: pick your rules, plan for Halloween, and see what a month without alcohol did in a published study. Sourced.
- [Dry January App: Free Options and What to Look For](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/dry-january-app): Which apps help you track Dry January, including the free Try Dry app. A checklist for choosing one, plus what the research on a month off shows.
- [Sober Curious: Meaning, Origins and How to Start](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-curious): What sober curious means, where the term comes from, why more Americans are drinking less, and how to run a low-pressure experiment. With sources.
- [Is Reframe Free? Reframe vs I Am Sober Cost](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/reframe-app-cost): What the Reframe, I Am Sober, Sunflower and Sober apps cost, taken from their App Store listings and dated, plus how to cancel a subscription.
- [Gray Area Drinking: What It Means and What to Do](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/gray-area-drinking): What gray area drinking means, who popularised the term, why some experts question the label, how NIAAA defines heavy and binge drinking, and where to get help.
- [Best App to Quit Drinking: How to Choose (2026)](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/best-app-to-quit-drinking): Whether you want to stop, cut down or take a month off, which kind of app fits, what a large trial found, and when an app is not enough.
- [Sober App for Women: What Exists and What to Look For](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-app-for-women): Most sobriety apps are built for everyone. What exists for women, why women-specific support matters, the numbers behind it, and what to look for.
- [Sober Girl App: Features, Price, Privacy, Platforms](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-girl-app): What the Sober Girl app is, who makes it, what is free and what is Plus, how it handles privacy, where it runs, and what it is not.
- [Alcohol-Free Days: How Many a Week and How to Track](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/alcohol-free-days): What counts as an alcohol-free day, what NHS and NIAAA guidance says, and a simple way to track your drinking pattern, with an app or without.
- [Sobriety Calculator: Days Sober, Money Saved, Milestones](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sobriety-calculator): Free sobriety date calculator. Enter your last drink date to see days sober, weeks, months, money saved and your next milestone. Runs in your browser and stores nothing.
- [Urge Surfing: What It Is and How to Do It](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/urge-surfing): Urge surfing means watching a craving rise and fall without acting on it. What it is, how to do it step by step, and what the evidence does and does not show.
- [How to Stop Alcohol Cravings: What Helps, and When](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/how-to-stop-alcohol-cravings): NIAAA-backed strategies for alcohol cravings, how to build a plan for your triggers, the medications a doctor can discuss, and when to get help.
- [How to Quit Drinking on Your Own: Safe Steps](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/how-to-quit-drinking-on-your-own): When you can quit drinking on your own, when you should not, and a practical plan: pick a date, remove alcohol, plan for urges, and line up support.
- [Benefits of Quitting Alcohol: What the Evidence Supports](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/benefits-of-quitting-alcohol): The measured benefits of a month without alcohol, what people self-report, and what the evidence says about sleep, liver and cancer risk. With sources and limits.
- [Sober Journal Prompts: 30 Questions for Early Sobriety](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-journal-prompts): 30 journal prompts for early sobriety, grouped by moment: day one, cravings, social events, mood, and milestones. Plus how to keep a sober journal that you will stick with.
- [What to Do Instead of Drinking: Evenings, Events, Drinks](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/what-to-do-instead-of-drinking): Practical ideas for what to do instead of drinking: evening routines, social plans, alcohol-free drinks, and how to fill the time you used to spend drinking.
- [Hangxiety: Why You Feel Anxious After Drinking](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/hangxiety): What hangxiety is, what a UCL and Exeter study found about next-day anxiety, how it differs from withdrawal, what to do, and when to get help.
- [Sober Books and Podcasts for Women: What Exists](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-books-and-podcasts): A facts-only directory of sober podcasts and books, including Quit Like a Woman, This Naked Mind and Sober Curious, with hosts, episode counts and listing dates.
- [Dry January: Benefits, Rules and Tips for 2027](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/dry-january-guide): What Dry January is, the benefits people report and what a study measured, how to set your rules, tips to get through the month, and what to do if you slip.
- [Printable Sobriety Calendar: 30, 60, 90, 100, 365 Days](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sobriety-calendar): Free printable sobriety calendar. Choose 30, 60, 90, 100 or 365 days, add your start date, and print or save as PDF. Runs in your browser and stores nothing.
- [How Much Alcohol Is Too Much for a Woman? NIAAA Limits](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/how-much-alcohol-is-too-much-for-women): What counts as a standard drink, how NIAAA defines binge and heavy drinking for women, what the NHS advises, and how to count your own week.
- [How to Stop Drinking Wine Every Night: A Practical Plan](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/how-to-stop-drinking-wine-every-night): Is a glass of wine every night too much? What one glass really counts as, how it compares with NIAAA and NHS guidance, and a practical plan to cut back or stop.
- [Alcohol and Weight: Calories, Gain and Quitting](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/alcohol-and-weight): How many calories are in a standard drink, what research says about alcohol and weight gain, and what a month without alcohol did to weight in one study.
- [Is Drinking Alone a Problem? What Research Shows](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/drinking-alone): Is it bad to drink alone? What a meta-analysis found about solitary drinking and alcohol problems, why context matters, and questions to ask yourself.
- [Alcohol and Depression: What the Research Says](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/alcohol-and-depression): How alcohol and depression are linked, what a review found about the direction of the link, what it means if you drink to cope, and where to get help.
- [Sober Holidays: Halloween to New Year’s Eve Plan](https://shipailab.com/sobergirl/sober-holidays): A practical plan for staying alcohol-free through Halloween, Thanksgiving, December parties and New Year’s Eve: what to say, what to bring, how to leave.
